title: Revenue undercounting from a bad INNER JOIN
issue_description: Total revenue for 2024-01-20 looks lower than expected -- a handful of completed orders placed by recently-signed-up customers seem to be missing from the fct_daily_revenue dashboard metric entirely.
ground_truth_root_cause: sql_models/01_stg_orders_cleaned.sql joins raw_orders to raw_customers using an INNER JOIN. Orders placed by customers whose customer_id hasn't yet landed in raw_customers (e.g. a brand-new signup still propagating through the customer sync job) are silently dropped by the INNER JOIN instead of being kept (with a fallback/unknown region), undercounting revenue in fct_daily_revenue for any day with such orders.

ground_truth_location.detail: The JOIN between raw_orders (alias o) and raw_customers (alias c) should be a LEFT JOIN, not an INNER JOIN.
